name: LoadMore
description: Load-more control with pending and end-of-list states.
designIntent: Paginated lists without page numbers need one consistent load-more control that announces loading and the end of the list. LoadMore keeps the row layout and state copy in one place.

examples.title: Deal grid pagination
examples.description: A load-more control below a card grid.

antiPatterns.title: Don't keep the button when the list is complete
antiPatterns.explanation: Replace the button with the end message so there is no dead action.

accessibility.implementation: The wrapper uses aria-live polite; loading disables the button and sets aria-busy
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep loading and end labels short

compositionRules.relationship: Place LoadMore below the card grid
